mapper.select: SELECT wr.id, wr.code, wr.supplier_name, wr.approve_status, wrd.sku_no, wr.bill_date, wrd.receive_qty, wrd.exceed_qty, wr.delivery_warehouse_name, wr.receive_user_name, wr.purchase_user_name, wrd.remark, wrd.purchase_order_detail_id FROM warehouse_receive_detail wrd INNER JOIN warehouse_receive wr ON wrd.main_id = wr.id AND wrd.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE wr.is_deleted = FALSE AND wr.purchase_order_id = #{purchaseOrderId}
